environment: Virtual machine; no governor or frequency controls. Team CPU work paused during both timed runs.
study_scope: Direct AVX512 body kernels; complete 3-byte/4-character quanta only. Both alphabets; padding and public dispatch are outside this probe.
build_commands: rustc --edition=2021 -D warnings -C opt-level=3 -C target-cpu=x86-64 -C codegen-units=1 -C lto=thin probe.rs -o probe-generic
rustc --edition=2021 -D warnings -C opt-level=3 -C target-cpu=native -C codegen-units=1 -C lto=thin probe.rs -o probe-native
sampling: Rotate variant order by sample; variants share one binary; fixed iteration counts; preallocation and preparation outside timed intervals; black_box inputs and results; output/error checks outside timing.
aggregation: Each workload uses median ns/call of eleven samples. Speedup=baseline median/candidate median. aggregate.csv geometric means combine six equally weighted alphabet/alignment workloads for each fixed size and case. paired_median_speedup pairs samples by index.
throughput: Only valid cases receive GB/s, computed as raw binary bytes / ns. Invalid cases report latency only.

validation.illegal_byte_coverage: all 256 byte values at every position for lengths 4,8,28,32,60,64,68,128,252,256,260,512

decision: Reject unconditional production replacement. Both candidates regress the 4095-byte workload on both builds; decode also regresses 384 bytes. Larger decode gains are retained as limited experimental observations, not a general speed claim.

assembly_observations.encode: Bulk loop has three full loads versus four masked loads; two VPERMB plus two VPERMT2B input permutations versus four VPERMB; three additional index constants loaded once after bulk guard. Four multishift and four alphabet VPERMB operations unchanged. No vector spills in bulk loop.
assembly_observations.decode: Bulk loop has three VPERMT2B plus three full stores versus four VPERMB plus four masked stores. Two additional compaction index constants loaded once after bulk guard. Existing lookup register copies remain; no additional shuffle input copies and no vector spills in bulk loop.
assembly_observations.short_paths: Disassembly confirms added bulk index constants are loaded only after full-block size guards.
assembly_observations.hypothesis: Cross-vector permutations couple adjacent vectors and can change scheduling/execution cost; extra constant setup can matter near bulk boundaries. No instruction-level counter or independent microbenchmark establishes the dominant cause. Reduced load/store instruction count alone did not improve all workloads.

noise_controls: decode3 encode is unchanged and compiler-merged with baseline encode; encode3 decode source is unchanged. Their retained measurements expose timing/code-layout variation. encode3 and combined encode are compiler-merged too.
